statement: Smoke of the H-absent entry on real CIFAR-100 images. It does not test the hypothesis and it is not a method.
voided_evidence: No accuracy from discriminate.json is evidence.
basis_definition: Same accumulated gradient-projector basis as h_absent.json, with a smaller rank and cap.
aggregation: One synchronous update from the round-start snapshot. X <- ((N-S)/N) X + (1/N) sum_{i in S} X_i, and C <- C + (1/N) sum_{i in S} (C_i_new - C_i_old).
evaluation: mean_absent_client_old_task_accuracy on each absent client's own test partition, pooled over all previous tasks.
test_partition: Independent Dirichlet partition of the CIFAR-100 test examples, saved with hashes.
contrast: shared minus client_specific, paired by seed
reject_if: The 95% bootstrap interval of the mean paired difference of mean_absent_client_old_task_accuracy across seeds covers 0 or lies at or below 0.
ns_role: Not the training step. Spectral norm about 1.199 does not satisfy ||D||_2 <= 1.
